Page 9 Cont.
Dec. 6 Kathleen Broe - 9 - from Bay City - carried in .... pneumonia etc ... 2 yrs unable to sit up or stand ... Enrolled 2nd time
Page 10
Dec. Edw'd Demps - 6'2 - down with asthma. Mrs. Donna Martin - 24 - inward cancer - given up by medical .... mother of 3 little children.
Thomas A. Gibson - 56 - deaf and dumb since childhood - went blind also two years ago. - Parents near relatives .???...
Dec. 12th Thanks - Mrs. Genevieve De Hate - 34 - heart, nerves, very weak legs .... Enrolled Dec. 4th promising perpetual En. - if 50% better in week. To-day Dr. Surprised .... says "she is fifty percent im- proved." Enrolls Today 5.00
15 Elizabeth Wagner - 47 - serious operation last June. .. recovery slow- Drs had figured on her living 3 months ... still here
16 Anthony Pittiglia - 4 - invalid since birth - seemingly bright other- wise but not able to stand or talk.
17 Robert Kruck - 19 - Ruptured appendicitis & pneumonia - operation three weeks ago, hopefully improving but still in danger ....
James Bent - 54 - Maningitis & strep .. in Womens Hosp.
Page 11
Dec. 17 Edwin A. Knapp - 5 - malignent groth in Eye - Drs spoke about re- moving Eye.
17 Christine Giffin - 68 - Baptist - Strathroy Hospital - mental .. asked for a priest ... Stanley Caplon - 13 - Jewish
18 Wm Hendrie - 56 - Episcopelian - Stroke five years - progressive- E ....
Mrs. Ellen O'Henley - 67 - broke leg last 19 June .... bad set - Drs say it must be broken again - Started a perpetual enrollment To-day Baby Mary Foley - a year old - sight doubtful .. ..
